name: agent-control
description: Local agent control plane for reusable configured agents, declarative flows, Codex orchestration, supervision, and live inspection through MCP, CLI, and a native console.

interface.shortDescription: Configured agents, declarative flows, and live supervision
interface.longDescription: A deterministic local control plane and native Codex console for running declarative flows, bridging root-owned Codex subagent v2 actions, supervising Codex and OpenCode workers, recording artifacts and transitions, polling only cheap external status, visualizing agent relationships, exposing compact local API/WebSocket state, and delivering durable event subscriptions with renewable waits and explicit acknowledgement. Find and converse with existing project tasks, attach their sessions and the requester to a shared run, and use native Codex communication when Agent Control is unavailable. Create reusable named agents with individual Codex models, instructions, and ordered plugin, skill, and MCP selections; configure and launch them from the console or tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $development-flow to clarify a software task and run development-flow-v1.
Use $flow-author to design or refine declarative Agent Control flow configs.
Use $configured-agents to discover, configure, or invoke a saved Agent Control agent.
